_notes.status_write_exemptions: Step 16c writes milestones[].status='done' to Steps 09/14 on verified milestones. Without this exemption, file-level change detection triggers E550 requiring full downstream replay, creating an infinite cycle.
_notes.downstream_consumers: Records which steps actively consume each step's output. Read by 'specdev prompt-context'. NOT used by the forward-replay check (which uses positional ordering in 'steps').
_notes.step_metadata: Per-step declarative metadata. required_spec_inputs is the inverse of downstream_consumers (producers that feed into this step) — kept redundant for O(1) lookup and consistency validation. required_seed_inputs mirrors seed_manifest.step_requirements. extraction_intent is a one-line human-readable summary for prompt and doc generation.

00.extraction_intent: Read seed documents (overview, tech stack) and author the project charter: problem statement, scope, stakeholders, success metrics.

01.extraction_intent: Ingest charter scope and user segments; derive named capabilities grounded in charter goals.

02.extraction_intent: Consume capabilities and baseline architecture seed; produce component boundaries, tech stack, and connections.

02a.extraction_intent: Read system sketch; derive delivery baseline (environments, compliance, CI gates, secrets).

03.extraction_intent: Glossary from charter, capabilities, and system-sketch terms; canonicalize vocabulary for downstream steps.

04.extraction_intent: FR list derived from charter scope (in/out), capabilities, and glossary; each FR traces to a capability.

05.extraction_intent: Interface contracts bound to system components (02), FRs (04), and glossary (03).

06.extraction_intent: Invariants bound to components (02), FRs (04), and interfaces (05).

07.extraction_intent: NFRs derived from charter success metrics (00), components (02), delivery baseline (02a), glossary (03), and FRs (04).

08.extraction_intent: Fixtures covering components (02), delivery baseline (02a), FRs (04), interfaces (05), invariants (06), and NFRs (07).

09.extraction_intent: Implementation plan (milestones, tech stack, tasks) derived from charter, capabilities, system sketch, delivery baseline, FRs, interfaces, NFRs, and fixtures.

10.extraction_intent: Governance rules (commit patterns, PR rules) derived from charter, system sketch, delivery baseline, and impl plan.

11.extraction_intent: Red team (threats, mitigations) derived from components (02), FRs (04), interfaces (05), invariants (06), NFRs (07).

12.extraction_intent: CI gates derived from delivery baseline (02a) and governance (10).

13.extraction_intent: Extension generator derived from capabilities, system sketch, FRs, interfaces, NFRs, fixtures, and red team.

13a.extraction_intent: Completeness assessment derived from charter, capabilities, FRs, interfaces, fixtures, CI gates, and extensions.

14.extraction_intent: Roadmap (milestones, tasks) derived from charter, capabilities, system sketch, FRs, fixtures, impl plan, red team, CI gates, extensions, completeness.

15.extraction_intent: Scaffold derived from system sketch, delivery baseline, FRs, interfaces, fixtures, red team, and roadmap.

16.extraction_intent: Trinity Anchor (scope declaration) derived from FRs, interfaces, fixtures, impl plan, red team, CI gates, roadmap, and scaffold.

16a.extraction_intent: Milestone plan (checklist) derived from delivery baseline, FRs, interfaces, invariants, NFRs, fixtures, red team, CI gates, completeness, roadmap, scaffold, and anchor.

16b.extraction_intent: Execution evidence derived from delivery baseline, fixtures, red team, CI gates, completeness, roadmap, scaffold, anchor, and 16a plan.

16c.extraction_intent: Semantic review derived from delivery baseline, FRs, fixtures, red team, CI gates, roadmap, anchor, and 16b execution.
